questions.question_english: A teacher with a high Need for Achievement (nAch) according to McClelland’s theory is most likely to exhibit which of the following characteristics?
options_english: A constant, overriding desire to maintain warm friendly relationships with all colleagues, even at the direct expense of task efficiency.
A preference for moderately risky tasks with immediate performance feedback.
A driving psychological desire to dominate departmental staff meetings and strictly control the instructional behaviour of peer teachers.
A strong preference for engaging exclusively in highly routine, repetitive administrative tasks that carry zero inherent risk of failure.
questions.explanation_english: Individuals high in Need for Achievement seek personal mastery, set moderately challenging yet realistic goals, and take responsibility for outcomes. They prefer tasks carrying moderate risk where success depends on effort rather than chance, and they desire concrete, immediate feedback to measure their personal performance.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। उच्च उपलब्धि की आवश्यकता वाले व्यक्ति व्यक्तिगत महारत की खोज करते हैं, मध्यम चुनौतीपूर्ण लेकिन यथार्थवादी लक्ष्य निर्धारित करते हैं, और परिणामों की जिम्मेदारी लेते हैं। वे ऐसे कार्यों को पसंद करते हैं जिनमें मध्यम जोखिम होता है, जहां सफलता प्रयास पर निर्भर करती है, न कि संयोग पर, और वे अपनी व्यक्तिगत प्रदर्शन को मापने के लिए ठोस, तात्कालिक फीडबैक की इच्छा करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) A preference for moderately risky tasks with immediate performance feedback.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Individuals high in Need for Achievement seek personal mastery, set moderately challenging yet realistic goals, and take responsibility for outcomes.

questions.question_english: According to McClelland’s theory, an individual’s specific needs are:
options_english: Learned and developed through life experiences and cultural background.
Genetically inherited at birth and remaining completely fixed and unchangeable throughout an individual’s lifetime.
Determined exclusively by basic biological survival drives and underlying physiological neurological mechanisms.
Dictated entirely by an individual’s official employment classification and current baseline administrative pay scale.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that individual needs are learned and developed through life experiences and cultural background. McClelland’s theory asserts that motivational needs are acquired through social environments, education, and cultural upbringing over time, rather than being genetically inherited or fixed at birth. This allows for the evolution of individual motivational profiles through training and experience.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। जीवन के अनुभवों और सांस्कृतिक पृष्ठभूमि के माध्यम से सीखी और विकसित की जाती हैं। मैकक्लेलैंड का सिद्धांत यह बताता है कि प्रेरक आवश्यकताएँ जीवन के अनुभवों, सामाजिक वातावरण, शिक्षा और सांस्कृतिक परवरिश के माध्यम से विकसित होती हैं, न कि केवल आनुवंशिक रूप से विरासत में मिली या जन्म के समय स्थिर। यह प्रशिक्षण और अनुभव के माध्यम से व्यक्तिगत प्रेरक प्रोफाइल के विकास की अनुमति देता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Learned and developed through life experiences and cultural background.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: McClelland’s theory posits that motivational needs are acquired and developed through life experiences, social environment, education, and cultural upbringing over time.

questions.question_english: In Vroom’s model, ‘Instrumentality’ refers to the connection between:
options_english: Performance level and subsequent outcome
Individual effort input and performance achievement
Received organizational reward and personal career goals
Personal inherent ability and clear role perceptions
questions.explanation_english: Instrumentality represents the subjective probability belief connecting achieved performance to specific organizational outcomes or rewards. It reflects an employee’s trust that achieving designated performance standards will reliably lead to receiving expected rewards, recognition, or career benefits promised by institutional management.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। इंस्ट्रुमेंटैलिटी उस व्यक्तिगत संभावना विश्वास का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है जो प्राप्त प्रदर्शन को विशिष्ट संगठनात्मक परिणामों या पुरस्कारों से जोड़ती है। यह एक कर्मचारी के विश्वास को दर्शाता है कि निर्धारित प्रदर्शन मानकों को प्राप्त करना अपेक्षित पुरस्कारों, मान्यता, या करियर लाभों को प्राप्त करने की दिशा में विश्वसनीय रूप से ले जाएगा जो संस्थागत प्रबंधन द्वारा वादा किया गया है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Performance level and subsequent outcome
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Instrumentality represents the subjective probability belief connecting achieved performance to specific organizational outcomes.

questions.question_english: ‘Organisational Citizenship Behaviour’ (OCB) in a school setting is strongly predicted by intrinsic motivation. Which of the following acts best exemplifies OCB?
options_english: A teacher voluntarily staying back after school hours to counsel a distressed student without requesting compensatory leave.
A teacher punctually submitting all continuous comprehensive evaluation records prior to the officially stated deadline.
A teacher diligently attending every mandatory parent-teacher meeting scheduled within the official school calendar.
A teacher systematically completing the entire prescribed subject syllabus well within the established academic timeline.
questions.explanation_english: A teacher voluntarily staying back after school hours to counsel a distressed student without requesting compensatory leave exemplifies Organizational Citizenship Behaviour (OCB). OCB refers to discretionary, voluntary actions that exceed formal job descriptions and are not explicitly recognized by formal reward systems. Spending personal uncompensated time to counsel a student demonstrates discretionary helpfulness, deep commitment to student welfare, and selflessness, serving as a classic manifestation of organizational citizenship in education.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। एक शिक्षक बिना मुआवजे की छुट्टी की मांग किए बिना एक distressed छात्र को सलाह देने के लिए स्कूल के घंटों के बाद स्वेच्छा से रुकता है। संस्थानिक नागरिकता व्यवहार (OCB) उन स्वैच्छिक क्रियाओं को संदर्भित करता है जो औपचारिक नौकरी के विवरण से परे जाती हैं और जिन्हें औपचारिक पुरस्कार प्रणालियों द्वारा स्पष्ट रूप से मान्यता नहीं दी जाती है। एक छात्र को सलाह देने के लिए व्यक्तिगत रूप से बिना मुआवजे का समय बिताना स्वैच्छिक मदद, छात्र कल्याण के प्रति गहरी प्रतिबद्धता और निस्वार्थता को दर्शाता है, जो शिक्षा में संस्थानिक नागरिकता का एक क्लासिक उदाहरण है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) A teacher voluntarily staying back after school hours to counsel a distressed student without requesting compensatory leave.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Organizational Citizenship Behaviour refers to discretionary, voluntary actions that exceed formal job descriptions and are not explicitly recognized by formal reward systems.

questions.question_english:
From the options listed below, identify the factor that
    Herzberg classified as a 'Motivator':
options_english: Institutional administrative policies and governance rules
Quality and fairness of supervisory oversight by managers
Base financial compensation and salary structure levels
The work itself, including job nature and core content
questions.explanation_english: Herzberg identified the core work content itself as a primary motivator. Engaging, meaningful, and challenging work directly satisfies higher-order psychological needs, generating positive job satisfaction, intrinsic drive, and personal commitment, whereas environmental context elements serve merely as hygiene maintenance factors.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। हर्ज़बर्ग ने मुख्य कार्य सामग्री को एक प्राथमिक प्रेरक के रूप में पहचाना। आकर्षक, अर्थपूर्ण और चुनौतीपूर्ण कार्य सीधे उच्च-क्रम की मनोवैज्ञानिक आवश्यकताओं को संतुष्ट करता है, सकारात्मक नौकरी संतोष, आंतरिक प्रेरणा और व्यक्तिगत प्रतिबद्धता उत्पन्न करता है, जबकि पर्यावरणीय संदर्भ तत्व केवल स्वच्छता रखरखाव कारकों के रूप में कार्य करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) The work itself, including job nature and core content
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Herzberg identified the core work content itself as a primary motivator.

questions.question_english: Identify the correct pair according to Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory:
options_english: Hygiene Factor – Sense of personal achievement in work
Motivator Factor – Quality of physical working conditions
Motivator Factor – Level of salary and contractual security
Hygiene Factor – Interpersonal relations with colleagues

questions.question_english:
Which of the following is NOT a common method
     an employee might employ to restore equity when
     feeling under-rewarded?
options_english: Demanding that their own salary be reduced to match a colleague’s
Asking for a salary hike or better perks (increasing outcomes)
Slacking off on the job (decreasing inputs)
Changing the ‘referent other’ (comparing themselves to someone worse off)
questions.explanation_english: Under Equity Theory, employees who feel under-rewarded typically seek equity by either increasing their outcomes or decreasing their inputs. It is uncommon for individuals to voluntarily request a reduction in their income when they feel under-rewarded. Instead, they are more likely to demand raises, reduce their effort at work, change their cognitive perceptions of their referent peers, or even leave the organization to address perceived inequity.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। इक्विटी सिद्धांत के अनुसार, कम पुरस्कारित कर्मचारी आमतौर पर अपने परिणामों को बढ़ाकर या अपने इनपुट को घटाकर संतुलन बहाल करने की कोशिश करते हैं। जब लोग कम पुरस्कारित महसूस करते हैं, तो वे स्वेच्छा से अपने वेतन में कमी की मांग नहीं करते। इसके बजाय, वे वेतन वृद्धि की मांग करते हैं, कार्यस्थल में प्रयास को कम करते हैं, संदर्भ साथियों की संज्ञानात्मक धारणाओं को बदलते हैं, या असमानता को हल करने के लिए पूरी तरह से संस्थान छोड़ देते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Demanding that their own salary be reduced to match a colleague’s
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Equity Theory, under-rewarded employees seek equity by increasing outcomes or decreasing inputs.
